automatic_rule: evidence confidence >=threshold AND presence>=threshold or <=1-threshold; category coherent. Otherwise new GPT fallback same medium model/prompt, no shared baseline response.
statistics: paired per criterion; 2 repetitions test stability, not sample size; report raw counts and medians, no population efficacy claim
correction_scope: review record and image annotations; do not manufacture surveyed 3D dimensions from uncalibrated photo
